result.summary: The application interface is mostly functional, but there is a notable visual layout issue involving text overlap/clipping on the 'Popular right now' card.

issues.description: The delivery fee tag '€0 delivery' on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is slightly overlapping or poorly aligned with the image content, and the overall card design looks like it might be missing a restaurant name/title text beneath the image area compared to other standard list items.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the badge is positioned with sufficient padding and check the hierarchy to ensure the restaurant title is clearly visible.

issues.description: The text 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' is very close to the edge of the screen and lacks consistent padding relative to the image container above it.
issues.suggestion: Adjust margins and padding to ensure consistent spacing between images and text labels across all card types.
